card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical term that is split up, such as path|ologic, Dys|menorrhea, dys|pareunia, or SY|NDROME in capitals. It also fires on small words just before the name of a syndrome.

card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of a long split medical word, such as path-ologic, dys-menorrhea or syn-drome.
